conditions.zh-CN: 不包含真实告警、密钥、同步绑定或默认动作；已有数据不会自动猜测映射
conditions.en: Includes no real alerts, keys, synchronization bindings or default actions; mappings to existing data are not guessed automatically

conditions.zh-CN: 本资源尚未完成真实模型端到端验收；需先核对目标业务和字段，再由本人采用
conditions.en: This resource has not completed real-model end-to-end acceptance; review the target business and fields before personal adoption

summary.zh-CN: 告警记录、未完成数量、状态与严重度分布、近30天趋势；选择目标业务核对映射后预览采用。
summary.en: Alert records, open counts, state and severity distributions, and a 30-day trend. Select a target business, review mappings, then preview and adopt.

now.zh-CN: 提供告警记录页和告警总览页的完整配置
now.en: Provide a complete alert records page and overview configuration

now.zh-CN: 根据已保存的告警记录计算未完成数量、状态、严重度与时间趋势
now.en: Compute open counts, state and severity distributions, and time trends from saved alert records

needs.zh-CN: 选择目标业务并逐项核对对象、字段与页面映射
needs.en: Select a target business and review object, field and page mappings

needs.zh-CN: 自行导入告警记录；SIEM/EDR连接、同步和业务动作需另行配置
needs.en: Import your alert records; configure SIEM/EDR connections, synchronization and business actions separately

permissions.zh-CN: 配置草案须预览并由本人采用
permissions.en: Preview the configuration draft and adopt it personally

permissions.zh-CN: 不自动授予员工、工具或外部系统权限
permissions.en: Does not automatically grant employee, tool or external-system permissions
